Terminal GUI for monitoring Firedancer metrics, snapshots, gossip, repair, and replay.

# Purpose
This file implements the `watch` command for Firedancer. It checks the permissions needed to run the command in a sandboxed process, then joins the topology workspaces in read-only mode and enters a restricted execution environment with seccomp rules and an allow list of file descriptors. The command reads live metrics from tiles and links in the Firedancer topology and prints a terminal user interface that updates in place.

The main logic is in [`run`](<#run>), which takes periodic snapshots of tile and link metrics, computes deltas between samples, and formats status lines for major subsystems such as `backt`, `snapct`, `gossip`, `repair`, and `replay`. Helper functions such as [`diff_tile`](<#diff_tile>), [`diff_link`](<#diff_link>), [`total_crds`](<#total_crds>), and [`total_regime`](<#total_regime>) compute metric changes and totals, while [`write_summary`](<#write_summary>) builds the screen output. The file also defines the `fd_action_watch` action record, which exposes the command as a public CLI action named `watch`.
